why: The deserts need both pieces: the descending branch's compression warming (e71, inland, dry, below the plateaus) and its dry-air descent (e70b), the latter switched off under raining air (e70c). The search balances their strengths and gates against the downstream rain of the semi-arid summer-rain margins (Kalahari, South Brazil, SW Australia) and north-east China.
